An '''Aqualish''' was present at a street market on the [[planet]] [[Caraad]] sometime during the [[Imperial Era]]. After witnessing the [[Force-sensitive]] [[Tarlafar]] [[Bayrn]] use [[the Force]] while at a market, the [[Aqualish]] hired the [[Duros]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]] to capture the [[youngling]].<ref name="Identity Crisis" />
